title_o: Intention Invention and the Affect Misattribution Procedure

replications.quote: We did not replicate the finding that standard and skip AMP effects are similar to one another. Whereas Payne et al. (2013; Experiment 3) found no difference between a skip and standard AMP, we found a difference between the two, such that scores on the standard AMP were significantly larger than those on the skip AMP (which were also in the opposite direction to what the original authors found).
